source: Part 15.3 of Cross-scale Multi-circle Structural Reasoning Framework v8.2

common_rule.text: Every application freezes D0, SP, K, time window, sources, affected and low-power positions, applies PF-1 through PF-10, records source gaps, and keeps authorization_effect none.

dynamic_entry.when: Whenever one of the nine application modules needs dynamic analysis, it must additionally declare all nine items below.
dynamic_entry.model_output_rule: Model-generated scenarios stay hypothetical or simulated and are never written back as observed.
downgrade_exits: When a simple baseline is sufficient, keep the simpler module record.
The existence of the complex flow never becomes pressure toward real-world disposition.

dynamic_focus.focus: role activation, inability to exit, and slow, medium, and fast states
metrics, bridging, propagation, and institutional writeback
representation, low-visibility positions, cross-layer aggregation loss, and calibration drift
material channels, capacity, thresholds, delays, and emergency authorization

contracts.object_and_method: Treat the bounded interaction, commitments, boundaries, responsibility sharing and return flow as the object, never either person's personality; separate relationship, individual psychology, family institution and coercion or violence events, and re-register SP and K after conversion.
protected_positions: people dependent on shared housing, resources or care
positions with lower exit, identity, safety or reputation power
children, family members or supporters exposed to spillover
contracts.evidence_scope: Partial coverage supports lightweight questions about safety, one-way responsibility, return flow, repair willingness and respected boundaries. It does not establish personality, causal responsibility or intervention effectiveness; violence, coercion, property, housing or guardianship consequences require external domain procedures.
allowed_output: candidate T0-T4 task, favoring T0 or T4 when safety is threatened
prohibited_leap_or_action: do not diagnose personality or illness
do not infer consent from silence, delay, anonymous or proxy submission
do not authorize mediation, compelled disclosure, separation or property disposition
do not require continued exposure in the name of love, duty or maturity
stop_or_failure_boundary: stop joint diagnosis or dialogue for violence, coercion, chronic humiliation, resource control, isolation, sustained deception or inability to exit freely
stop when refusal or withdrawal is ignored, retaliation follows feedback, or material is used to locate or shame a person
lower exposure, preserve only necessary evidence and move to independent safety, professional or legal support
contracts.next_handoff: Send evidence gaps to ariadne-evidence, bounded domain risk to ariadne-audit, and safety, psychological, medical, property or legal questions to an independent qualified human service; Ariadne supplies no action authority.

contracts.object_and_method: Separate household co-residence, care, resources, intergenerational carrying and member rights from relationship pairs, individual safety events and outside institutions; renew K when birth, death, illness, migration, guardianship or economic dependence changes the object.
protected_positions: members unable to leave or speak safely
contracts.evidence_scope: Partial coverage identifies care and resource gaps, private transfer of life-event costs and no-exit risks. It cannot determine consent, guardianship, care allocation, property or medical facts without child-protection, medical, guardianship or domestic-violence protocols.
allowed_output: candidate T0-T4 task and external protocol requirements
prohibited_leap_or_action: do not treat family-level interest as cancellation of member rights
do not presume consent from dependence or inability to leave
do not assign care duties or authorize contact with children or dependent people
do not decide guardianship, property, medical care or forced family meetings
stop_or_failure_boundary: stop a shared family process when dependent-person safety worsens, help-seeking returns to the challenged power chain, resources are withdrawn in retaliation, or disclosure raises risk
protect minimum resources and evidence, enable proxy or temporary buffer, and transfer to independent professional procedure
contracts.next_handoff: Handoff to the applicable child-protection, medical, guardianship, domestic-violence or legal process and to ariadne-audit for record protection and contestability.

contracts.object_and_method: Map a frozen organization's or project's goal-resource-role-execution-feedback-responsibility chain; keep organization, project, department, role, process and person distinct, and rebuild K when moving among them.
protected_positions: temporary, contractor, maintenance and care work
people locked in by income, visa, résumé or care duties
feedback providers and external affected parties
contracts.evidence_scope: Partial coverage supports return-flow, transmission, middle-carrier and responsibility-chain questions. Industry, role, labor relation and project-cycle claims need site records, grouped data and independent review; their absence limits output to audit questions and reversible test requirements.
allowed_output: bounded risk and carrying or return-flow breakpoints
prohibited_leap_or_action: do not turn framework labels into personnel judgments
do not infer organization-level facts from a few individuals without a scale bridge
do not authorize scoring, hiring, discipline, dismissal, contract or financial change
stop_or_failure_boundary: freeze downstream personnel use if a diagnosis is used for employment action
stop when dissent produces performance, scheduling, promotion, contract or resource retaliation
protect reporters, preserve the original record and require independent appeal and rollback
contracts.next_handoff: Handoff site verification to qualified organizational, labor and domain reviewers; send any contemplated option to ariadne-choice and every high-impact use to ariadne-audit.

contracts.object_and_method: Freeze the text-rule, parameter-rule, interface-rule, model, distribution, behavior-response and data-writeback chain; register platform, model, interface, content network, user group and social impact separately, and renew K after any objective, parameter, entry point or model-version change.
protected_positions: people subject to automated eligibility or visibility decisions
contracts.evidence_scope: Substantial framework coverage supports network, diffusion, parameter, recommendation-loop and automated-governance questions, but every concrete platform, dataset, model version, measurement protocol and result is external evidence. Unfrozen versions or parameters block causal attribution and extrapolation.
allowed_output: versioned parameter and interface audit questions
prohibited_leap_or_action: do not treat published text as the effective rule without parameter and interface evidence
do not infer consensus or merit from popularity
do not authorize data access, deletion, throttling, banning, model or parameter change, or labor eligibility action
stop_or_failure_boundary: stop expansion when object version changes, group harm crosses a threshold, human review is unreachable or rollback capacity disappears
roll back the frozen version and preserve affected records
treat post-appeal throttling, banning or income change as retaliation
contracts.next_handoff: Handoff platform facts to authorized platform and independent technical reviewers, rights questions to the applicable external process, and the versioned audit record to ariadne-audit.

contracts.object_and_method: Freeze jurisdiction and time window for the institution's rule-execution-resource-eligibility-feedback-responsibility-public-commitment structure; distinguish legal text, policy, executor, budget, informal rule, public object and affected groups.
protected_positions: people dependent on basic public services
contracts.evidence_scope: Substantial rule-level coverage supports high-power, distribution, public-commitment, polycentric and capture checks. Concrete legality, execution, budget, affected-group evidence and causal evaluation remain external; missing them permits risk questions, not legitimacy or policy-effect claims.
prohibited_leap_or_action: do not equate legal validity with normative legitimacy
do not use majority, stability or aggregate benefit to erase rights
do not infer execution from paperwork
do not authorize legislation, enforcement, budget, eligibility, regulation or public-resource disposition
stop_or_failure_boundary: stop when appeal and review are controlled by the same power chain, a rights floor is crossed, emergency rules become permanent, or the framework is used as legitimacy decoration
restore ordinary rights and procedure and roll back propagated records
contracts.next_handoff: Handoff legality, budget, service and rights questions to the proper independent public or legal authority; send choices to ariadne-choice and governance failures to ariadne-audit.

contracts.object_and_method: Treat public interpretation as a frozen event-issue-group-network-platform-time object; separate fact, evidence, acknowledgement, explanation, responsibility, identity and action, because heat is neither the public nor representativeness.
protected_positions: people without agenda or public-relations resources
people subject to harassment, throttling or employment consequences
contracts.evidence_scope: Partial coverage supports fact-evidence-explanation separation and propagation checks. Representativeness protocols, measurement contracts, platform data and intervention effects remain missing; without them, do not turn heat into consensus, a sample into the public or correlation into causality.
prohibited_leap_or_action: do not classify critics as instability mechanisms by identity
do not force affected people to prove themselves publicly
do not treat apology as compensation
do not authorize comment deletion, throttling, opinion control, identity disclosure or labeling the public
stop_or_failure_boundary: stop when the fact version changes, response raises exposure, platform action exceeds authority or corrections cannot write back to the propagation chain
publish a traceable correction and protect the original and corrected records
contracts.next_handoff: Handoff verification to independent source and measurement processes, platform actions to the proper external authority, and correction, appeal and retention duties to ariadne-audit.

contracts.object_and_method: Freeze coordinates, functional meaning, users, time window and dependency layers for a space-channel network; distinguish physical location, functional network, administrative boundary, service area and infrastructure layer, and map nodes, bottlenecks, capacity, alternatives and recovery lag.
protected_positions: people with limited mobility, health, income, digital access or expression
people unable to migrate or detour
contracts.evidence_scope: Substantial framework coverage supports bottleneck, center-edge, layered-infrastructure and recovery-geography questions. Engineering data, capacity thresholds, facility inventory and field verification are external; a missing critical parameter limits output to survey and measurement requirements.
prohibited_leap_or_action: do not treat map connectivity as adequate capacity, substitutability or accessibility
do not infer engineering feasibility or channel safety from structural language
do not authorize road closure, population movement, land taking, public-resource dispatch or engineering change
stop_or_failure_boundary: stop when field observation conflicts with the map, an alternative route is not operating, or a change increases edge harm
restore channel and service and transfer to field and engineering authority
contracts.next_handoff: Handoff measurements and safety decisions to qualified field, engineering and public authorities; retain the bounded requirement and contestability record in ariadne-audit.

contracts.object_and_method: Freeze incident phase, critical functions, command-information-resource chains, affected area and recovery window; keep hazard, incident system, emergency organization, critical function and recovery system separate, with distinct success criteria for rescue, stabilization, repair and rebuilding.
protected_positions: people unable to evacuate or decide
people reporting danger or refusing unsafe orders
contracts.evidence_scope: Substantial framework coverage supports normal-accident, near-miss, drift, functional-contraction, command and recovery-chain questions. Hazard thresholds, statutory command and professional operation cards come from the domain system; absent field confirmation or a responsible professional, Ariadne only records and flags risk.
allowed_output: post-event review once professional response has priority
prohibited_leap_or_action: do not delay life-saving action to complete structural analysis
do not replace medical, fire, engineering or incident command
do not authorize evacuation, dispatch or treatment
do not extend emergency power beyond its external expiry
stop_or_failure_boundary: immediately defer when professional field information contradicts the model, incident phase changes, action exceeds authority or emergency authority expires
restore ordinary rights and procedures after the emergency and preserve a reviewable record
contracts.next_handoff: Handoff immediately to the valid professional incident commander or emergency service; Ariadne remains a recording and post-event review aid with authorization_effect none.

contracts.object_and_method: Freeze boundary, levels, jurisdictions, time window, critical subsystems, resource-transmission-return flows and external response for the nested system; re-run object conversion, nine-axis ordering and K at every local-to-whole, short-to-deep-time or organization-to-institution move.
protected_positions: people unable to exit a territory, institution or basic system
contracts.evidence_scope: Substantial framework coverage supports blind-zone, applicability-switch, stress-test and intervention-priority questions. Unified data, case registration, causal identification, representativeness and cross-domain governance are object-specific; missing layered samples, capacity, execution chain or rollback evidence blocks whole-system extrapolation.
allowed_output: layered stress tests and independent review
prohibited_leap_or_action: do not infer the whole from a locality, execution from central intention, or J authority from wider observation
do not treat plan completeness as resources or short-term stability as slow-variable health
do not authorize one-size-fits-all or cross-domain governance
stop_or_failure_boundary: stop expansion when grouped harm spreads, resources or execution capacity fall below assumptions, metrics systematically conflict with field reports, local appeals cannot write back, or rollback capacity is insufficient
withdraw layer by layer and preserve local minimum services and exemptions
contracts.next_handoff: Handoff domain facts and jurisdiction to the responsible external authorities, maintain independent layered review, and send any scaled option through ariadne-choice and ariadne-audit before action.
